I’m not complicated. As long as there’s whipped cream and my age on her butt, I’m in.
And I can eat it all by myself.

The year can only get better. I don’t see what you could give me that’s better.
A new PC? Nah. A new keyboard? Nah. Just give me my girl with whipped cream—that’s all I want, no more.
I could die like this, no worries. Food poisoning? No worries. Just let me go like this.
